style.name: Pixel art
style.description: Pixel art builds images from deliberately placed pixels, often working within a limited palette and resolution. Crisp edges and repeated pixel units can extend from illustration into borders, icons, and interface details.

fonts.heading: Press Start 2P
fonts.rationale: A pixel display font supplies the game-like voice while a larger monospaced body face supports longer instructions.

tips: Keep a consistent apparent pixel size.
Use pixel lettering sparingly and generously sized.
avoid: Tiny text in dense pixel fonts.

recipe.composition: Work with block geometry, crisp edges, and a coarse rhythm; pair pixel display lettering with readable body text.
recipe.motion: Use discrete state changes rather than flickering sprites; never communicate a state through animation alone.
recipe.signature: Pixel-aligned forms and nostalgic game language with modern interaction clarity.
